fixed_claim: Same independently selected request/source/toolchain/target/profile/instance; no weakened property accepted.

controls.mutation_or_case: Unmodified whole observation under selected fixed request
Reuse same candidate against a different consumer-selected target, or mutate claimed triple/spec
Reuse generic_id::<u8> observation for generic_id::<u64> (and reverse)
Relabel C/system or same-shaped functions without the selected definition identity
Change aggregate return indirect mode to direct, leaving source/request fixed
Toggle NoAlias/NoUndef or alter pointee size/alignment without changing passing bits
Omit c_variadic/fixed_count/selected promoted extra argument (one control each)
Change HFA/cast unit, prefix, total or consecutive property
Reuse opt0 candidate under opt2 fixed profile or wrong CPU/features
controls.expected: reject request/profile binding even if a queried field coincides

controls.mutation_or_case: Present changed source hash/bytes under same label without changing consumer request
controls.expected: reject preflight; no arbitrary source compilation

controls.mutation_or_case: Duplicate key, unknown field, oversized/deep input, truncated/empty packet (separate controls)
Attempt extra arguments on fixed signature
controls.expected: reject selector before invoking query assertion

controls.mutation_or_case: Compiler/runtime failure, missing callback, missing/malformed observation or unknown status
controls.expected: stop and diagnose; never accepted/reclassified as expected semantic rejection
